votes.evidence: I extracted frame 439 from outputs/clip2/annotated.mp4 and from test_clips/clip2.mp4 (rows 346:954), then viewed both full size plus a 2.2x zoom of the athletes. Frame 439 is in the second match with the HARVEST boards. The raw frame shows both judoka. The white-gi athlete stands in front with his back to the camera and JPN on the gi. The blue-gi athlete is clearly behind him. His face and head show over the white athlete's right shoulder. Blue gi is visible at the white athlete's left flank. Blue trousers and legs show between and beside the white athlete's legs, and his bare feet are at the bottom. In the annotated frame the only overlay is red: a dashed A box labelled "A (white gi) colour-split 0.40" with a fragmentary skeleton, all on the white athlete. There is no green box, no green skeleton and no B tag on the blue athlete. The top-left HUD reads "B (blue gi): LOST (no pose)". B is therefore reported lost while he is plainly visible, so the lost_but_visible error is present at this frame. I found nothing that refutes it. Images are in /tmp/claude-0/-home-user-Grappling-rig-app-v2/9af305d0-b71a-552d-b344-ad580d75284a/scratchpad/verify/ (c2ann_439.png, c2raw_439.png, v439_pair.png)."

Frame 439 (annotated, outputs/clip2/annotated.mp4, 'frame 439 shot 1') shows the HUD "B (blue gi): LOST (no pose)". No green box, tag or skeleton is drawn. Only A (red, colour-split 0.40) is drawn, as a dashed box with a partial skeleton. The raw frame 439 (test_clips/clip2.mp4, rows 346:954) shows the blue-gi athlete clearly. Blue trousers and legs are visible behind the white athlete's legs, with a blue left leg at roughly x 415-460, y 260-460 and a blue right leg at roughly x 580-615, y 340-430. Bare feet show on both sides, and a head with dark hair is visible over the white athlete's shoulder. The project's own audit_notes.md also lists frames 439-443 as "B lost while visible", so the dropout lasts about 5 frames, 439-443. The error is present at exactly frame 439. The only mitigating factor is that B is mostly occluded, with just slivers of blue showing, but the visible blue legs and trousers are still clearly identifiable."
